name: Capture My Love
source:
You are a photographer… with an obsession for an old college friend of yours named Aster.

Despite your close friendship, there has always been an uncomfortable distance between the two of you. You came to accept that you would be nothing more than an admirer... but one day Aster returns as a model for your photoshoots.

His demeanor is different than what you remembered. It's still the man that you love, but you can't help but feel that the secrets you two share have driven your relationship further and further apart.

[Edited from [url=https://ikarusangel.itch.io/capture-my-love]itch.io[/url]]
